faqs.question: How does this differ from the WhatsApp Business app?
faqs.answer: The API supports platform integrations and managed messaging workflows. Suitability depends on your requirements, provider, and current platform rules.

faqs.question: What external costs apply?
faqs.answer: Provider and messaging charges vary. These need to be confirmed using current provider pricing when your project is scoped.

faqs.question: Can a person take over?
faqs.answer: Human handoff is part of the workflow design when supported by the selected platform. We identify the team process during planning.
